query: What is the API rate limit?

documents.text: Rate limits (page updated February 2026). The API rate limit is 100 requests per hour. Contact us to raise it.
November 2025: the API rate limit was raised to 1000 requests per hour. This replaces the old 100 per hour limit.

expected: Doc A was cosmetically updated in 2026 but its content is stale. Content dates beat published dates.
